sentences.text:
S, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY
ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the liberty granted by this Court in Crl.P.No.4098/2024 disposed of on 06.02.2024, the petitioner may be permitted to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file a fresh petition before the trial Court on the ground that there is no progress in trial 2.
The aforesaid submission is placed on record.
3. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
4. In the event petitioner files an application seeking regular bail before the Trial Court, the same shall be considered on merits and disposed of as expeditiously as possible.
5. All contentions urged in this petition are kept open.

Sd/-
